title: Recycling round
summary: Sort the cans at the recycling point, then swap a full bag.

steps.title: Sort the cans
steps.instruction: Deposit cans go in the round CANS opening of the white bin. The black square opening is PLASTIC, for other plastic.
steps.say: Deposit cans go in the round CANS opening, not the plastic.

criteria: No can or bottle is over or in the black square PLASTIC opening
A can that is over an opening is over the round CANS opening
check.warning: That's a deposit can. It goes in the CANS hole.

source.quote: Deposit cans go in the round CANS opening, not the plastic.

steps.title: Swap a full bag
steps.instruction: When the plastic bin is full, tie the bag and put a new one in.
steps.say: When the bin is full, tie the bag and put a new one in.

source.quote: When a bin is full, tie the bag and put a new one in.
